title: TJ hears each update once on the phone: replies from assistant and subassistant sessions are not shown or read to him alongside Tally's combined update that covers them

requirements.text: When a session reply is relayed to Tally, the phone presents only Tally's update about it, not the relay or subassistant reply as a separate item or message
requirements.check: a queued check relays one session reply through Tally and counts phone items: exactly one for that task

requirements.text: TJ confirms he no longer hears the same update twice
requirements.check: manual: TJ uses the phone for a round of updates with no duplicates

text: Cause: relay-begun Tally turns are walked whole (Tally's items rule covers only [phone] messages), restating its earlier update (01:52 answer, then 01:53/01:54/01:55 relay replies). Also: 02:25 phone message delivered twice (queued_command + prompt 02:26:31), answered twice. Fix: empty items block = shown, not walked (52 bridge tests pass); Tally instruction added in Voice.swift. Needs: bridge restart (asked T-WXFPX) and Mac app rebuild.

Bridge fix live 02:33 UTC (restart OK'd by the desk session): empty items block = shown, not walked. Second cause fixed in Delivery.swift: a queued_command attachment counts as arrived, so a phone message taken mid-turn is not retyped and answered twice (5 DeliveryTests pass). Voice.swift instruction and Delivery fix need a Mac app rebuild + relaunch: TJ's call.

Mac app relaunched 22:07:59 local from a binary built 22:07:36 that contains both fixes (strings: queued_command, the relay items rule): the double-answer fix is live. Tally's own Claude process (3063f4c1) dates from 20:50 and survived the relaunch, so its system prompt lacks the relay rule until Tally restarts; told directly instead. Next: a queued phone message is not retyped.
All code committed and shipped in phone build 0.1.456743; no phone build needed. Left: TJ confirms on the phone (or from the bridge log).
